# Enable core Bluetooth stack
CONFIG_BT=y
CONFIG_BT_HCIUART=y
CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_LOOPBACK=y
CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_TX_BUF_COUNT=8
CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_RX_BUF_COUNT=8
CONFIG_BT_L2CAP=y
CONFIG_BT_GATT=y
CONFIG_BT_SMP=y

# Enable Mesh and required features
CONFIG_BT_MESH=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_PROV=y
CONFIG_BT_MESH_RELAY=y

# Disable mutually exclusive Friend and Low Power features
CONFIG_BT_MESH_FRIEND=n
CONFIG_BT_MESH_LPN=n
